1. Theory
According to the principle of Faraday electromagnetic induction, a large amount of energy is quickly discharged from large-capacity storage capacitors to the coil. The coil is stimulated by strong current to produce pulse magnetic field, it can penetrate clothing, bones and other tissues, generate inductive electric fields in stimulating parts, causing excitement/suppression activities of nerve cells, and then generate a series of physiological biochemical reactions.
Magneto Therapy pulses a magnetic field into the body, creating an extraordinary healing effect. The results are less pain, reduction in swelling, and increased range of motion in the affected areas.
 
 
 
TMS is divided into sTMS, pTMS, and rTMS according to the stimulus mode.
sTMS: A single-time magnetic field with a non-fixed frequency is used to observe the instantaneous effect, and it is mostly used for conventional electrical physiological examinations.
pTMS: Based on a specific time interval and intensity, 2 stimuli is given to one specific area or two different parts, which are mostly used to study the easilyization and inhibitory effects of the nerves.
rTMS: During a certain area, the magnetic field is changed at a certain frequency. When the stimulus stops, there is still a continuous biological effect. It is a powerful tool for brain function research and clinical treatment.
 
 2. Application
It uses magnetic field to stimulate muscle tissue and nerves through clothes and skin without decaying, so that it generates inductive current, a non-invasive, painless stimulus to tissue and peripheral nerves, which can accelerate metabolism and blood circulation, enhance the body immunity, soothe pain, reduce muscle soreness, restore damaged cells to normal health, regulate and improve physical function.
(1) Muscle pathology (contracture, muscle tears, bruises and swelling).
(2) Bone injuries, osteoarticular distractions and wear of the joints (shoulder, hips, knees, ankle joints).
(3) Pathology of the elbow, wrist and arms (epicondylitis, tendinitis, carpal tunnel syndrome).
(4) Thoracic vertebral pathology.
(5) Inflammation and damage to the Achilles tendon and ligament.
(6) Tendonitis in the shoulder joint area and chronic edema.

DR.MEDEX IFT Vacuum Therapy Machine – Advanced Physiotherapy Equipment
The DR.MEDEX I.F.T. Vacuum Therapy Machine is designed for physiotherapy clinics, rehabilitation centers, and professional healthcare facilities seeking combined interferential therapy (I.F.T.) and vacuum therapy functionality in one compact unit.
Combining electrical stimulation controls with adjustable vacuum suction, this machine supports professional physiotherapy treatments aimed at pain management, muscle stimulation, and rehabilitation. Its intuitive control panel provides intensity adjustment, treatment timer settings, mode selection, channel balance control, and adjustable vacuum control.
 
Key Features
 • Combined I.F.T. and Vacuum Therapy: Integrates interferential therapy controls with vacuum suction functionality in one unit.
 • Adjustable Intensity: Dedicated controls for adjusting the stimulation output.
 • Dual-Channel Connections: Red and blue output ports grouped into CH-1 and CH-2.
 • Adjustable Vacuum Control: Allows the operator to adjust suction according to the device's specifications and treatment protocol.
 • Timer and Mode Selection: Provides treatment timer and mode controls.
 • Frequency and Time Presets: Front-panel presets for selecting available treatment parameters.
 • User-Friendly Interface: Clearly organized controls and indicator lights.
 • Compact Design: Suitable for professional physiotherapy and rehabilitation environments.
 • Worldwide Shipping Support: A compatible power cable can be supplied according to the destination country, subject to order configuration.
 
Applications
The machine may be used by trained physiotherapy professionals as part of appropriate treatment protocols for:
 • Musculoskeletal pain management
 • Muscle spasm and stiffness management
 • Back, neck, and shoulder rehabilitation
 • Selected joint and soft-tissue conditions
 • Sports injury rehabilitation
 • Physiotherapy and mobility rehabilitation programs
Treatment suitability depends on the patient's condition, clinical assessment, device specifications, and professional guidance.
 
Designed for Professional Physiotherapy
DR.MEDEX combines practical controls and integrated therapy functionality to support physiotherapy professionals in their daily clinical work. Consult the product manual for complete operating instructions, contraindications, electrical specifications, and approved accessories.
